entries.effect: the completion handler, with no information and the framework's own ENErrorCodeUnsupported; after -invalidate the same handler is answered with ENErrorCodeInvalidated, which is what that code documents
entries.source: SDK 26.2's ENManager.h for the signature and the rule, and the 12.5/13.5/14.4 band it arrived in; the release runs no exposure-notification service: the framework arrived in iOS 12.5 and 6.1.3 carries no EN class and no EN symbol, the service needs an entitlement and a per-device authorization no port can grant itself, and ENManager.h says the Bluetooth Low Energy subsystem it broadcasts over is required, which iOS 6 does not run
